architecture-review.json.review: Workbench retains typed caller/source pairing and receipt model. Canonical migration changes only two checks, preserving keys/rows and refusing downgrade with inherited evidence. No project references, runtime partials, service locators, caches or queries added; EF-generated migration partial is required tooling. Existing module/type cycles and 204 analysis diagnostics must not be claimed as clean solution health. Direct Workbench/Migrations/Unit/Integration Release builds pass. All 75 selected contract/runtime/migration cases pass; generated 10,921-line EF target-model size finding is accepted as standard migration metadata. Canonical snapshot changes only two receipt checks.
architecture-review.json.validation: 75/75 selected tests passed (34 Unit, 41 Integration), including 16 new cases. All four direct Release builds, EF no-pending-model check, reviewed idempotent SQL and final full portability enforcement (15,646 findings) pass. Complete frozen source/runtime identities verified unchanged. Full observer coverage; zero remaining observed processes and database-name delta. Six unowned TEMP deltas preserved. This validates receipt origin partition and compatibility only; actual inherited Workbench/Process producer, manager, historical continuation and Workflow remain open.

migration-review.json.review: One transaction, two check constraints replaced, no column/index/key/data changes. Down guard takes an exclusive table lock and refuses retained inherited receipt evidence. Runtime migration/restart/downgrade tests pass; EF model consistency passes.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: All 75 selected cases passed: 34 Unit and 41 Integration, including 16 new caller/source/SQL migration cases. Existing interactive paths and retained receipt compatibility pass. New inherited Workbench adapter and actual producer remain closed; historical cleanup denials remain open.

observer-startup-failure.json.repair: Refresh this one reviewed baseline pin and companion manifest identity only. Frozen source/runtime unchanged. No tests or observer child had started.
observer-startup-failure.json.failure: Observer refused startup before tests: resource source pin still named the baseline before its reviewed four generated-model additions.

portability-review.json.review: Four generated migration target-model properties copied unchanged from the canonical model: RootPathState, RootPathSyntax, RaisesEscalation and EscalationCount. They are EF metadata, not filesystem or Process execution behavior. No new platform dependency; the migration changes only the two reviewed receipt checks.
